study: Gersten et al. 2010, Teacher Study Group (TSG) reading PD, AERJ 47(3)
eval_evidence: The TSG model was developed by the authors' research team ('based on our earlier...'); the same research team designed and conducted the RCT, so the evaluation is developer-authored.
developer_evidence: Five TSG facilitators (research-team-affiliated; two of them helped develop the TSG curriculum) led the study-group sessions; delivery was by the program team/their facilitators, not by the school system.
cascade_evidence: Research-team facilitators ran the 16 study-group sessions with teachers directly; no train-the-trainer intermediary hop.
counterfactual_evidence: Control schools received only the district's mandated Reading First PD and did not participate in TSG; a treatment-as-usual condition.
coaching_evidence: Intervention was 16 facilitator-led collaborative study-group (after-school) sessions; no ongoing in-class coaching/observation of individual teachers.
student_dose_evidence: TSG changes grade-1 teachers' vocabulary/comprehension instruction only; no student-facing tutoring or added dose.
maturity_evidence: TSG implemented as a one-academic-year program (16 sessions over ~9 months); outcomes measured at end of that single implementation year; no multi-year maturity axis.
